title: Separatedness and local finite presentation are Zariski local on the target
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ be a set-indexed open cover of $S$. Write $f_i:f^{-1}(U_i)\to U_i$ for the restriction. Then $f$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism] if and only if every $f_i$ is separated. Also $f$ is locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] if and only if every $f_i$ is locally of finite presentation. The covering and the schemes need not be quasi-compact.
